title: Galaxy post card
description: An editorial card on black: a 2:1 image with 5px corners, an uppercase grey kicker (category • date), a 20–24px title and optional outlined topic chips. The whole card is one link; on hover the title greys out. A row layout puts a square cover beside the text (podcasts).
notes: the image slot shows a muted placeholder until media is passed
